summary: CleanCore Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Contribution Agreement, LLC Agreement, and Master Platform Agreement with HST Technologies (Platform Co) to form a joint venture for data center development. CleanCore will contribute up to $100M cash for a 99% capital interest; Platform Co contributes assets for a 1% interest and 20% carried participation after a 12% preferred return. The JV targets up to $2B total commitments. Platform Co manages, but CleanCore has major-decision approval and removal rights. This is a non-M&A capital commitment, not a classic special situation. What to watch: funding timing and potential dilution if commitments are missed.
